## Specific task description

Task instruction: Use both arms for the kitchenpot with two side handles

Task description: The target is the lidded pan at the center of the table, with a side handle on both left and right. Use both arms to lift it together.

Success criteria: Lift the pot sufficiently to leave a clear gap beneath its bottom, with its opening up and body roughly upright. The left and right grippers must be near the grasp regions of the corresponding handles in the current image.

## Execution tips

- Prefer grasping the middle of the outer handle sections on both sides, away from the pot wall and corners, leaving effective contact area for the pads.
- Match the gripper opening to the rod thickness and surrounding clearance. Before closing, confirm both fingers are actually on opposite sides of the handle, rather than merely overlapping in the image or touching the pot wall or lid.
- During lifting, move both handles upward together and keep them at similar heights, reducing tilt and slipping caused by loading one side first.
